verses.text: I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

segments.text: I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up,
And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.text: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

segments.text: O Jehovah my God,
I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.text: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

segments.text: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol;
Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.text: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial name.

segments.text: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his,
And give thanks to his holy memorial
name

verses.text: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning.

segments.text: For his anger is but for a moment;
His favor is for a life-time:
Weeping may tarry for the night,
But joy
cometh
in the morning.

verses.text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

segments.text: As for me, I said in my prosperity,
I shall never be moved.

verses.text: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

segments.text: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong:
Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

verses.text: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:

segments.text: I cried to thee, O Jehovah;
And unto Jehovah I made supplication:

verses.text: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

segments.text: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit?
Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.text: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.

segments.text: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me:
Jehovah, be thou my helper.

verses.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

segments.text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing;
Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.text: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
